can_change_plans: Can I change my plan anytime?
yes_change_plans_anytime: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your subscription plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately.
commission_calculation_explanation: Commissions are calculated on the final sale price and vary by category and subscription plan. Local orders over $150 receive additional discounts.
payment_schedule_explanation: Payments are processed within 2-3 business days after order completion. You can track all earnings in your seller dashboard.

event_marketing_explanation: Create local events, workshops, or promotions to engage customers. Higher subscription tiers include more events, analytics, and advertising benefits.
sponsored_events_explanation: Featured placement for your events in local search results and event calendars. Pro subscribers get 50% off, Enterprise gets featured placement included.
event_advertising_desc: Promote your events to the right audience with our flexible advertising options. Choose your geographic reach and frequency to maximize attendance.
city_wide_desc: Target customers in your specific city
monthly_desc: Perfect for regular events and promotions
monthly_annual_desc: Perfect for regular events - paid annually upfront
twice_monthly_annual_desc: Great for frequent promotions - paid annually upfront
weekly_annual_desc: Maximum engagement with weekly events - paid annually upfront
daily_annual_desc: Ultimate visibility with daily promotions - paid annually upfront
geographic_targeting_explanation: Your event will be promoted to users within your selected geographic area. City targets specific municipalities, Metro covers metropolitan areas, State reaches entire states, National covers the whole country, and International reaches global audiences.
subscription_vs_single: Subscription vs single event - which is better?
subscription_vs_single_explanation: Subscriptions offer consistent monthly rates billed annually upfront and are perfect for businesses with regular events. Single events are ideal for one-time promotions or testing different markets.
can_cancel_subscription: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
cancel_subscription_explanation: Yes, you may cancel your subscription at any time, however all annual subscription purchases are final. Your account will remain open for edits and posting of event notices for the remaining subscription period.
when_events_go_live: When do my events go live?
events_go_live_explanation: Single events activate instantly after payment. Subscription events can be scheduled in advance and will automatically go live according to your chosen frequency.
can_change_geographic_area: Can I change my geographic area?
change_geographic_explanation: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade your geographic reach anytime. For subscriptions, changes take effect with your next billing cycle.
monthly_annual_billing: Why is monthly advertising billed annually?
monthly_annual_explanation: Monthly advertising plans are billed annually upfront to provide significant cost savings (up to 80% off single event rates) and ensure consistent event promotion throughout the year.
